Careers

Career Opportunities

Sivan Design is always looking for talented individuals from diverse backgrounds to add to its growing team. If you believe you have what it takes, please e-mail your resume to: sales@sivandesign.com

Open Positions

USA

| Sales Manager |

Job description:

The sales manager will be in-charge of sales (and marketing) activities in the US. The activity will include sales through phone, e-mail and using other sales methods such as web-casting. The job includes road shows inside the US, visiting potential customers. The sales manager will also assist in building up a distribution/resellers network of the company’s products.

  • Ambitious, good personal skills and business oriented
  • Background in Civil engineering – must (architects are welcome as well). Advantage for roads designers
  • Past experience in sales and marketing – advantage
  • Knowledge in AutoCAD – advantage
ApplySend us your CV

 

| Technical Support Officer |

Job description:

The technical support officer will be in-charge of customer support. The support will be given through phone and e-mails on a daily bases.

  • Service oriented – must
  • Background in Civil engineering – must (architects are welcome as well). Advantage for roads designers
  • Knowledge in operating AutoCAD – must
  • Familiar with 3D models (3D MAX and others) – advantage
ApplySend us your CV

 

International

Kenya – Romania – Uganda

| Sales & Marketing Managers |

Responsibilities:
  • CivilCAD & Civil Simulate software sales
  • CivilCAD & Civil Simulate support and training
  • Understand customer needs and gather product requirements
  • Identify market opportunities
Requirements:
  • Academic Degree in Engineering/ Architecture
  • Excellent computer skills
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills
  • Great team player
  • Excellent analytical skills and attention to detail
  • Background in Sales and good Business sense
  • Must be self-motivated to prioritize and manage work load
ApplySend us your CV

 

Israel

| Training and Technical Support Manager |

Job description:

We are looking for a civil engineering software support expert, who will support the implementation, service and training processes for our clients. The job also requires product marketing and recruitment of potential clients. Contact us if you are up for the task and possess these qualities and qualifications:

  • Closely familiar with AUTOCAD products (a must)
  • Experience in CIvilCAD software (an advantage)
  • Experienced in work with Office programs
  • Diligence, punctuality, patience, reliability
  • Fluent in English (including client service and training experience in English)
  • Excellent people skills
ApplySend us your CV

 

| Software QA Specialist |

Job description:

Looking for a QA specialist for our comprehensive software solutions. Send your CV if you are an enthusiast for complex software systems, capable of user training in English, and ready to become key member of our development team. The job requires simultaneous involvement in several software systems, vast understanding of software architecture and some business process logic. Basic requirements are:

  • Experience in Software QA – minimum 1 year
  • Experience and knowledge in GIS (an advantage)
  • Ability for Online and Frontal training, mainly in English
  • Knowledge in Software Architecture
  • Excellent people skills
ApplySend us your CV
